recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore the moved resources for FHIR-7612; handle any future maturation or editorial cleanup in the admin-incubator/current resource-owner workstream or under a fresh R6 issue.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core issue requesting support for billing data and a way to distinguish billed encounter diagnoses/data from non-billed clinical data; the final resolution says Patient Administration created ChargeItem and ChargeItemDefinition, applied for R5.
initial_application: No commit explicitly names FHIR-7612, but ChargeItem was added as a draft resource in commit 813ca92a4d882bf3ff51928c5f7f5456674c0096 and ChargeItemDefinition was added in commit 3b94eeadabb3e6cecaef2f94874d228b7b0c397f for GF#16523. Jira FHIR-16523 confirms ChargeItemDefinition was pre-applied in revision 13743 after PA/FM/FMG approval.
additional_context: The current R6-oriented build does not list ChargeItem or ChargeItemDefinition as active resources in source/fhir.ini. Commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 removed the resource directories from core, and source/ballot-intro.html documents that both resources were moved to admin-incubator IGs as immature resources. The Financial module still lists active core billing/financial resources such as Account, Claim, ClaimResponse, Invoice, ExplanationOfBenefit, PaymentNotice, and PaymentReconciliation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Restoring ChargeItem or ChargeItemDefinition to core would reverse a later R6 scope decision rather than complete FHIR-7612.
